title: Finite-basis inverse for a natural Hom comparison
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open, A=Gamma(Y,U), and T any additive functor from A-modules to module sheaves on U. Suppose c(M,N):T(Hom_A(M,N)) -> internalHom(T(M),T(N)) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] is natural under precomposition by all source maps and c(A,N) is an isomorphism for every N. Then c(M,N) is an isomorphism for every finite free A-module M [def-weil-pbc-free-module] and every coefficient module N.

source.place: lemma-spec-sheaves, clauses (4)-(5) and functoriality; Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext, finite free Hom coefficient map

proof.text: Choose a finite basis of M. Its inclusion maps inc_i:A -> M and coordinate projections proj_i:M -> A satisfy sum_i proj_i >> inc_i = id_M. Precomposition L in associated Hom and H in sheaf Hom are additive contravariant operations, so they carry this decomposition to identity decompositions.

Define d = sum_i H(inc_i) >> inverse(c(A,N)) >> L(proj_i). Naturality for inc_i proves c(M,N) >> d = id; naturality for proj_i proves d >> c(M,N) = id. In both cases cancel the rank-one component and use the sum identity. An empty basis has empty sums and is covered by exactly the same identities.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_hom_comparison_isIso_of_finite_free
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (T : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1) ⥤ U.1.toScheme.Modules)
    (hT : T.Additive)
    (c : ∀ (M N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1)),
      T.obj (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, U.1) (M ⟶ N)) ⟶
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
          (T.obj M) (T.obj N))
    (hpre : ∀ (M M' N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1)) (f : M' ⟶ M),
      c M N ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (T.map f) (𝟙 (T.obj N)) =
      T.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (Linear.leftComp Γ(Y, U.1) N f)) ≫ c M' N)
    (hunit : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1),
      IsIso (c (ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Y, U.1)) N))
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U.1))
    [Module.Free Γ(Y, U.1) M] [Module.Finite Γ(Y, U.1) M] : IsIso (c M N)
